name: Wingclipper
benefit:
Whenever you confirm a critical hit against an
 opponent that uses wings to fly, you can forgo the extra
 critical damage to instead prevent it from flying for a
 number of rounds equal to twice the critical multiplier of
 your attack. Opponents that are flying at the time of the
 critical effect must succeed at a DC 20 Fly check to avoid
 taking falling damage.
flavor: Your attacks can prevent winged opponents from flying.
